styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting: confident black ink outlines, textured acrylic brushstrokes. Huge blazing orange, red and gold sunset or deep blue moonlit sky with tiny white dots like stars, figures as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.BOKMAN: a lean street painter in a patched brown jacket and headband
characters.YUN: a haughty court painter in a blue silk robe and gat
characters.MAKDONG: a skinny orphan boy in a ragged gray jacket
characters.MIN: a dignified white-bearded old nobleman in an ivory robe and gat

scenes.S01: [SIL] Sunset in a nobleman's courtyard: silhouettes of people holding up a tall painted folding screen against the glowing sun, a crowd watching in awe.
scenes.S02: [WEB] Close-up of a large Korean minhwa magpie-and-tiger painting on paper held up against bright sunset light, so a hidden small magpie painted on the back glows faintly through the paper beside the tiger. Nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S05: A lively Joseon market street in Hanyang: stalls with baskets, cloth and pottery, tiled and thatched roofs, blue mountains behind. Crowds small in the distance.
scenes.S06: At a market corner, BOKMAN sits on a straw mat painting a colorful magpie-and-tiger minhwa with a brush, finished paintings hanging on a rope behind him.
scenes.S07: Market villagers gather around a hanging magpie-and-tiger painting, laughing and pointing happily, a woman holding coins.
scenes.S08: YUN walks past a market stall with his nose in the air, covering his face with a silk fan, looking down scornfully.
scenes.S09: YUN stands over BOKMAN's paintings on the ground, sneering and pointing with his closed fan, BOKMAN looking up humbly.
scenes.S10: A thin orphan boy MAKDONG hides behind a wooden market post, clutching his empty stomach, staring at a rice cake stall.
scenes.S11: BOKMAN kneels and hands a small bright magpie-and-tiger painting to MAKDONG, both smiling, warm evening light.
scenes.S12: MAKDONG happily receives a rice cake from a kind rice-cake seller woman at her stall, holding up the small tiger painting.
scenes.S13: [SIL] Sunset under a stone bridge by a stream: a small straw shelter, a man and a small boy sitting side by side as silhouettes, a small fire.
scenes.S14: Inside a humble straw shelter at night lit by an oil lamp, BOKMAN paints carefully on the BACK side of a sheet of paper while MAKDONG watches curiously.
scenes.S16: In front of a government gate, a clerk pastes a large notice sheet on a wall while market people crowd around. The notice sheet is blank plain paper.
scenes.S17: BOKMAN and MAKDONG stand in front of a notice wall, MAKDONG tugging BOKMAN's sleeve excitedly, BOKMAN hesitant.
scenes.S18: BOKMAN kneels over a very large sheet of paper on the floor, painting a big magpie-and-tiger with total concentration, bowls of pigment around him.
scenes.S19: [SIL] Early dawn at the tall gate of a noble mansion, a man in plain clothes holding a rolled painting scroll, a small boy beside him.
scenes.S20: YUN unrolls a large magpie-and-tiger painting in a mansion hall, his face frozen in astonishment, eyes wide.
scenes.S21: YUN rolls the painting back up with a cold expression and turns away, while BOKMAN stands at the gate looking hopeful.
scenes.S22: [SIL] Night, a room lit by a single candle: the shadow of a man pressing a seal stamp onto a large painting spread on the floor.
scenes.S24: A grand noble mansion courtyard decorated for a 60th birthday feast: lanterns, tables of food, servants hurrying, guests in fine robes.
scenes.S25: [WEB] Scene in a noble mansion hall: 1. CENTER: a tall folding screen with a big magpie-and-tiger painting. 2. LEFT: YUN standing proudly with his fan, chin up. 3. RIGHT: noble guests admiring the screen. Nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S26: MAKDONG peeks over a stone wall into the feast, eyes wide with shock as he recognizes the tiger painting on the screen.
scenes.S27: Servants grab MAKDONG by the arms at the mansion gate while BOKMAN rushes in, alarmed, reaching toward the boy.
scenes.S28: [WEB] Scene in a noble mansion courtyard: 1. TOP, on the raised wooden hall: YUN pointing down angrily with his fan. 2. BOTTOM, kneeling on the ground held by two servants: BOKMAN, looking up. 3. BESIDE HIM: MAKDONG crying.
scenes.S29: Close-up of only one person: BOKMAN kneeling on the courtyard ground with his head bowed and eyes closed, fists clenched on his knees.
scenes.S30: Only one person in the picture: MIN sitting calmly at the center of a wooden hall, observing thoughtfully.
scenes.S32: Only one person in the picture: BOKMAN kneeling, lifting his head and speaking clearly and calmly, determination in his eyes.
scenes.S33: [SIL] Blazing sunset in a noble courtyard: servants lifting a tall painted folding screen high against the glowing sun, silhouettes of guests leaning forward.
scenes.S34: [WEB] Close-up of a magpie-and-tiger painting glowing with sunset light shining through the paper from behind: faintly appearing inside the tiger's stripes are a small magpie and a tiny smiling boy's face, painted on the back. Nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S35: Only one person in the picture: MAKDONG standing in a courtyard pointing up, tears streaming down his face, mouth open in amazement, warm sunset light.
scenes.S36: BOKMAN kneeling beside MAKDONG, one hand gently on the boy's shoulder, speaking with a warm smile.
scenes.S37: Only one person in the picture: YUN standing frozen on a wooden hall, face pale white, his silk fan fallen at his feet.
scenes.S38: MIN rises from his seat and gestures firmly toward servants bringing brushes, ink and two blank sheets of paper.
scenes.S39: [WEB] Scene in a noble courtyard, two painters side by side on mats: 1. LEFT: YUN sweating, his brush trembling over a smudged sheet. 2. RIGHT: BOKMAN painting calmly, a lively smiling tiger appearing on his paper. Guests watching. Nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S40: [WEB] Scene in a noble courtyard: 1. STANDING: MIN, stern and dignified. 2. KNEELING before him with forehead to the ground: YUN, his silk robe spread on the dirt. 3. BACKGROUND: BOKMAN and MAKDONG standing, surprised.
scenes.S41: MIN bends down and helps BOKMAN up from his knees by the arm, both faces warm.
scenes.S42: Only one person in the picture: YUN walking out of a mansion gate with his head bowed in shame, without his hat.
scenes.S43: BOKMAN and MAKDONG stand beside a cart piled with rice sacks, MAKDONG jumping with joy, BOKMAN laughing.
scenes.S44: A small cozy painting shop in the market with magpie-and-tiger paintings hanging outside, BOKMAN teaching several poor children to paint, MAKDONG among them holding a brush proudly.
scenes.S45: [SIL] Sunset over a Joseon village lane, many wooden gates each decorated with small magpie-and-tiger paintings glowing in warm light, silhouettes of children running.
